Since the right triangle of the diagram is <MATH_0009>-commutative we see that

is <MATH_0011>-commutative. Hence we obtain a <MATH_0012>-morphism

is a morphism of categories over <MATH_0016> (!) and an equivalence

Lemma <REF_0002>).
Hence <MATH_0018> is an equivalence in the <MATH_0019>-category of categories fibred
in groupoids over <MATH_0020> by
